name: ZCA_AG_RULES_PREVIEW_GT
description: This table would be populated when the user clicks the "Explore" button and would be retained there-after.

columns.name: RULE_GUID
columns.description: This field contains the Rule Guid which is a FK to the MOW_RULES table. This would be populated for Custom and Predefined Rules

columns.name: ACC_EXT_RULE_ID
columns.description: This field contains the Extension Rule Id which is a FK to the ZCA_AG_ACC_EXT_RULES table. This would be populated for Access Extension Rules

columns.name: CONDITION_CODE
columns.description: This field contains the Condition Code for Predefined Rules

columns.name: EXTENSION_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this rule is an extension rule. Value of "N" indicates it is a Custom or Predefined Rule.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: References values in ZCA_OBJECTS.LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE for both standard and custom objects

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: PK of the object. Eg., for Opportunity, this column will contain OPTY_ID.

columns.name: OBJECT_NUMBER
columns.description: PUID of the object. Eg., for Opportunity, this column will contain OPTY_NUMBER.
